terra.problem: Saying nobody gives a gift to someone they don't care about assigns a feeling to Merodach-baladan that the text does not give.
The text does not say there was no army or that the letters contained no threats.
The explanation is flat and repetitive: its final sentence simply restates what it already said Merodach-baladan sent.
Saying 'we won't joke about it' comments on how Papa tells the passage.
'I won't dress it up' comments on how Papa tells the passage.
Referring to the next card exposes the lesson format.
'He didn't call it harsh, so we don't either' is preachy and imposes a response the text does not require.
The explanation says Hezekiah said something next, but the verse gives his thought, not another statement.
'Keep listening' after saying the story isn't over implies a continuation, although this is the last passage in the story group.
'Then he thought' places Hezekiah's thought after his statement, but the text does not establish that sequence.
